name: rail-weak-words-mismatch
about: An empty road with no vehicle under the headline 'Drive a brand-new truck.': the words promise what the picture does not show. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `weak-words-mismatch`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: a new truck is promised over a picture with no truck in it

subject_legible.reason: A straight open road through golden fields toward a setting sun reads instantly and cleanly at phone size.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline promises a brand-new truck, but the picture shows only an empty road with no truck anywhere.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The large white headline on dark asphalt reads first and the white button second, though the yellow lane line cuts through the word NEW.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green footer band and the white button with green lettering match the brand colours; no logo was supplied, though the carrier's name appears nowhere.
